get_clusters.description: Cluster ingested source tracks and persist assignments in their SQLite database.

arguments.help: Existing source SQLite database containing ingested tracks
Positive primary clustering threshold in calibrated distance units
Positive separate temporal-layer threshold; inactive in spatial or joint mode (default: 0.1)
Use QuickBundlesX instead of the default DBSCAN
Enable day/week/month temporal features; spatial and temporal layers are separate unless --joint is passed
Minimum primary DBSCAN neighborhood size; ignored by QuickBundlesX (default: 5)
QuickBundlesX hierarchy multiplier, at least 1; ignored by DBSCAN (default: 2)
Seed from 0 through 4294967295 for pair sampling and QuickBundlesX ordering (default: 0)
IANA time zone for temporal features, e.g. UTC or Europe/Berlin, or local (default: UTC)
Cluster space and all calendar phases jointly, without a separate time layer; requires --spatiotemporal (default: separate layers)
Finite Lp metric exponent, at least 1; ignored in spatial mode (default: 2)
Maximum distinct track pairs for median distance calibration (default: 10000)

evaluate.description: Evaluate clustering results stored in one source database.

arguments.help: One ingested source database
Evaluate QuickBundlesX instead of DBSCAN
Threshold sweep; defaults depend on the selected algorithm
TOML reference clustering configuration; omit to use complete stored hand-made labels
Distinct pair-sampling/QuickBundlesX ordering seeds from 0 through 4294967295; at least one required for QuickBundlesX, may be empty for DBSCAN which uses seed 0 (default: 0 1 2 3 4)
QuickBundlesX hierarchy multiplier, at least 1; ignored by DBSCAN (default: 2)
Minimum primary DBSCAN neighborhood size; ignored by QuickBundlesX (default: 5)
One-based primary scoring layer; DBSCAN supports only 1 (default: DBSCAN 1, QuickBundlesX 3)
Enable day/week/month temporal features; spatial and temporal layers are separate unless --joint is passed
Positive separate temporal-layer threshold; inactive in spatial or joint mode (default: 0.1)
IANA time zone for target temporal features, e.g. UTC or Europe/Berlin, or local (default: UTC)
Cluster space and all calendar phases jointly, without a separate time layer; requires --spatiotemporal (default: separate layers)
Finite target Lp metric exponent, at least 1 (default: 2)
Maximum calibration pairs for target runs; independent of reference settings (default: 10000)

load_data.description: Import one GPX source or a configured batch into SQLite databases.

single.description: Ingest one GPX source and optional reference CSV into SQLite

arguments.help: Existing folder containing GPX files; subdirectories are not traversed
Required source key; writes outputs/KEY.sqlite
Display name recorded when creating the source database (default: source folder name)
Optional hand-made CSV with file_name,id,cluster; id is the zero-based track index within its GPX file
Provenance category for the supplied hand-made labels
Description of the supplied labels and their provenance
Policy for changed existing GPX filenames; identical checksums are always reused

batch.description: Ingest configured sources and references into their SQLite databases

arguments.help: TOML source configuration; input paths resolve relative to it (default: bundled analytics datasets.toml)

start.description: Prepare configured source databases sequentially, then serve the Bokeh dashboard.

arguments.help: TOML source configuration to ingest and evaluate (default: bundled analytics datasets.toml)
Prepare databases and exit instead of starting the dashboard (default: prepare and serve)
